Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It doesn't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.[Opponent's Turn] All of your other Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant], or [Fairy] in one of their traits gain "[On Deletion] Gain 2 memory, and return 1 Digimon card with 3000 DP or less from your trash to your hand."
